title: DurableKnowledgeSpecification
description: Schema for durable project knowledge including charter goals, ADRs, coding conventions, and domain vocabulary, conforming to core/schemas/memory.schema.json.

decisionId.description: Unique identifier for the architectural decision record (e.g., ADR-0001).

title.description: Concise summary title of the decision.

choice.description: The chosen architectural path or design solution.

consequences.description: Positive, negative, and operational tradeoffs and impacts of this decision.

goals.description: High-level durable project objectives and charter principles.

architecturalDecisions.description: Chronological or indexed registry of accepted architectural decisions.

codingConventions.description: Durable language, style, privacy, and architectural coding standards.

domainVocabulary.description: Key domain terms, acronyms, and business vocabulary mapped to their authoritative definitions.

oneOf.title: StandaloneDurableKnowledgeFile
oneOf.description: Durable knowledge structured as a standalone repository file with top-level fields.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the memory schema (e.g., 1.0.0).

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent durable knowledge update.
